name: EVCC, Energy
description: Live evcc snapshot: PV forecast vs actual, house, battery, grid, and optional charger. Works with any evcc instance on your network.

cell_options.name: url
cell_options.label: EVCC URL
cell_options.help: Base URL of your evcc instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7070

cell_options.name: loadpoint
cell_options.label: Loadpoint index
cell_options.help: 0 is the first charger. Only used when the vehicle panel is shown.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Leave empty to use the language default (Energy / Energie).

cell_options.name: vehicle_name
cell_options.label: Vehicle name
cell_options.help: Shown when evcc has no vehicle title (car unplugged). Leave empty for Auto / Vehicle.
